rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a set of intended actions aimed at a goal.

example.english: We already have a plan and will start carrying it out tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我哋已經有個計劃，聽日開始執行。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 jau5 go3 gai3 waak6 ting1 jat6 hoi1 ci2 zap1 hang4

rows.note: Use this for a technical drawing of a building, machine, or other object.

example.english: This plan clearly shows how to assemble the machine.
example.traditional: 呢張設計圖畫清楚晒部機點樣組裝。
example.jyutping: nei1 zoeng1 cit3 gai3 tou4 waa2 cing1 co2 saai3 bou6 gei1 dim2 joeng2 zou2 zong1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a top-down floor plan showing a building's internal layout.

example.english: The plan shows where the kitchen is.
example.traditional: 份平面圖標明廚房位置。
example.jyutping: fan6 ping4 min6 tou4 biu1 ming4 cyu4 fong2 wai6 zi3

rows.note: Use this for a recurring subscription package such as a mobile-phone or internet plan.

example.english: I switched to a monthly plan and save quite a bit.
example.traditional: 我轉咗用月費計劃，慳返好多。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zyun2 zo2 jung6 jyut6 fai3 gai3 waak6 haan1 faan1 hou2 do1
